Package com.j3d.gen.docs.reader.tokens.wrappers

Class TWhtmlTag

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.gen.docs.reader.tokens.TWrapper
com.j3d.gen.docs.reader.tokens.wrappers.TWhtmlTag
public class TWhtmlTag extends TWrapper
Represents an HTML tag token wrapper. This class parses an HTML string, extracts the tag name, attributes, and content, and provides methods to access them.
Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole

  • Method Details

    • read

      private void read(String content)
      Parses the given HTML string to extract the tag name, attributes, and content. It performs basic validation for matching opening and closing tags and valid HTML tag names.
      Parameters:
      content - The HTML string representing a single tag, e.g., <font t="d" what=10>hi</font>.

    • getTag

      public HTMLTags getTag()
      Returns the HTMLTags enum representing the HTML tag name.
      Returns:
      The HTML tag enum.

    • getAttributes

      public HashMap<String,String> getAttributes()
      Returns a map of attributes found in the HTML tag. The keys are attribute names (e.g., "t", "what") and values are their corresponding values (e.g., "d", "10").
      Returns:
      A HashMap where keys are attribute names and values are attribute values.

    • getTagContent

      public String getTagContent()
      Returns the content enclosed within the HTML tag.
      Returns:
      The string content of the tag, or null if no content was found.
